title: Distro manifest
description: The fragments that make up one distro's user-data, in src/distros/<distro>/manifest.json. The folder is named after the WSL distribution, and the build writes dist/<distro>.user-data.

fragments.description: Every fragment in the distro's user-data, in name order, which is the order cloud-init merges them in. Each is a file name without .user-data, found in the distro's own folder or in src/fragments/, but not in both.
